windowing.events_tracked: non-static requests only for path/time history; all requests for hit counters

descriptions.SAGE_NonStatic_Navigation_Gap: Median inter-arrival time in seconds between consecutive non-static requests in rolling window. Defaults to 0.0 if <2 non-static requests.
descriptions.SAGE_NonStatic_Long_Gap_Ratio: Fraction of consecutive non-static request intervals >= 0.50 seconds (500 ms human dwell time). Defaults to 0.0 if <2 non-static requests.
